resume_instructions: Each entry in sources[] has status pending|done|blocked. Re-run only sources not 'done'. Evidence cites pdf_page and the issuer's printed page separately.

rejected_facts.note: No rejection/quarantine ledger for this company exists in the repository or in the repo's data/financial.sqlite3 snapshot (exceptions table has no rows for it). The AWS production DB was out of bounds for this audit, so server-side rejected facts were not reviewed.

numeric_correctness.scope: all 135 published facts in arabian-cement-2025-fy.json (FY2025 and FY2024 comparatives)
numeric_correctness.note: Every value was matched to the cited statement line and column; composite metrics were re-added from their component lines; balance sheet and cash-flow pages were also checked on rendered images.

document_completeness.note: Primary statements are complete in the document but the extraction omits pre-tax profit, OCI components, basic and continuing-operations EPS, the statement of changes in equity, and most cash-flow adjustment and working-capital lines (see missing_fields).

company_coverage.note: Only FY2025 (+FY2024 comparatives) exists. No other fiscal year and no Q1/H1/Q3/9M period is published. The repository defines no expected-period list, so a coverage ratio cannot be asserted.
